class: A rule that reads 'when the position was entered' from a row's database-default creation time (clock_timestamp) instead of the order's own placed time gives the wrong day for any order written later than it was placed (a seed, an import, a backfill, a replay), and the app role cannot correct it because the column is not writable.
mechanism: S-12 reads the entry day from paper_orders.created_at (DB default clock_timestamp()); scripts/seed_scenario.py sets only placed_at (~line 169), so a seeded 3 Nov entry reads as the real day; UPDATE of created_at by the app role: permission denied for table paper_orders.

Live: placed_at is the order route's own clock at the same instant, so no change.
